announce.description:
Put the heading and description in a polite status, with actions outside
the region. Set before mounting a message that reports changed results.

heading.description: Localized heading that identifies the empty view. Blank text omits the heading.

heading-level.description:
Native heading level for the surrounding document outline. Only integers
from 2 through 6 are valid; unsupported values use level 3.

icon-name.description:
Optional decorative Lucide glyph. Register it with a per-icon import before
mounting. A supplied illustration takes precedence.

size.description: Use small inside a table or narrow panel. Unrecognized sizes use the medium layout.

tone.description: FeatureIcon tone. Unrecognized tones use the neutral tile.

--ki-empty-state-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter applied behind the empty view.

--ki-empty-state-bg-image.description: Optional image above the background color.

--ki-empty-state-description-bg.description: Background layer behind the supporting copy.

--ki-empty-state-description-fg.description: Supporting text ink, strengthened in contrast-more mode.

--ki-empty-state-description-line-height.description: Line height of the supporting copy.

--ki-empty-state-description-size.description: Font size of the supporting copy.

--ki-empty-state-gap.description: Gap between the decorative media, message and action row.

--ki-empty-state-gap-sm.description: Gap between regions in a compact empty view.

--ki-empty-state-heading-line-height.description: Heading line height in a regular empty view.

--ki-empty-state-heading-line-height-sm.description: Heading line height in a compact empty view.

--ki-empty-state-heading-size.description: Heading font size in a regular empty view.

--ki-empty-state-heading-size-sm.description: Heading font size in a compact empty view.

--ki-empty-state-max-width.description: Maximum inline size of the centered content.

--ki-empty-state-tile-danger-bg.description: Background of the danger decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-danger-fg.description: Glyph ink on the danger decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-info-bg.description: Background of the info decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-info-fg.description: Glyph ink on the info decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-neutral-bg.description: Background of the neutral decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-neutral-fg.description: Glyph ink on the neutral decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-primary-bg.description: Background of the primary decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-primary-fg.description: Glyph ink on the primary decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-primary-light-bg.description: Background of the primary-light decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-primary-light-fg.description: Glyph ink on the primary-light decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-radius.description: Corner radius of the regular fallback tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-radius-sm.description: Corner radius of the compact fallback tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-success-bg.description: Background of the success decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-success-fg.description: Glyph ink on the success decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-warning-bg.description: Background of the warning decorative tile.

--ki-empty-state-tile-warning-fg.description: Glyph ink on the warning decorative tile.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A short explanation and next step for an empty view.

container.description: Centered layout for the illustration, message and actions.

heading.description: Native heading at the selected document level.

announce.description:
Put the heading and description in a polite status, with actions outside
the region. Set before mounting a message that reports changed results.

heading.description: Localized heading that identifies the empty view. Blank text omits the heading.

Native heading level for the surrounding document outline. Only integers

iconName.description:

slots.description: Localized supporting text with a reason or recovery advice.

actions.description:
Optional controls for the next step, with at most one
primary action. In a guarded surface, bind actions to these controls.

media.description:
Optional decorative illustration in place of the icon. Use
an image with empty alt text or a decorative SVG. Keep this slot free of controls.
